newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-DERBY SIGN ITALY INTERNATIONAL ERANIO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DERBY SIGN ITALY INTERNATIONAL ERANIO.

text.p: English premier league club Derby signed Italian international midfielder Stefano Eranio from AC Milan on Tuesday.
Eranio, who is out of contract in the summer, has agreed a three-year deal, Derby manager Jim Smith said.
He won his 30th Italy cap against Poland last month and has been included in the squad for the Tournoi de France next month when Italy play England, Brazil and France.
